title: OASIS: A Rubric-Based Multimodal Assessment Platform Using Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.09180v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: OASIS (Open Assessment and Scoring Infrastructure Stack) is a systems platform for rubric-based grading of video, audio, and text with large language models. Scoring one artifact with an LLM is straightforward; deploying assessment at scale requires encounter management, rubric versioning, modality-aware execution, provenance capture, and human review. OASIS pairs a standalone command-line interface with a canonical integrated Elephant + MAPLES stack for encounter management and multimodal grading orchestration. Both paths can target hosted APIs or self-hosted open-weight models through Ollama and OpenAI-compatible endpoints such as vLLM. SimRubrics rubric authoring and the Wayfinder conversational agent gateway are optional extensions that use the same authenticated interfaces as human operators. translated_title: OASIS：一个基于评分规则的多模态大语言模型评估平台
translated_abstract: OASIS（开放评估与评分基础设施栈，Open Assessment and Scoring Infrastructure Stack）是一个系统平台，用于使用大语言模型对视频、音频和文本进行基于评分规则的评分。使用LLM对单个工件进行评分很简单，而大规模部署评估则需要会话管理、评分规则版本控制、模态感知执行、溯源捕获以及人工审核。OASIS将独立的命令行界面与规范的集成式Elephant + MAPLES技术栈相配对，用于会话管理和多模态评分编排。两种路径均可通过Ollama和OpenAI兼容端点（如vLLM）调用托管API或自托管的开源权重模型。SimRubrics评分规则编写工具和Wayfinder对话式代理网关是可选扩展，它们使用与人工操作员相同的经过身份验证的接口。给定评分规则和记录的会话，OASIS会生成针对每个评分标准的分数、证据和理由，并保留执行工件以供音频……
tldr: OASIS是一个基于评分规则的多模态评估系统平台，通过提供会话管理、评分规则版本控制、模态感知执行、溯源捕获和人工审核等基础设施，解决了大语言模型大规模评估部署的难题，并支持托管API与自托管开源模型两种部署方式。
en_tdlr: OASIS is a systems platform that enables rubric-based multimodal grading of video, audio, and text at scale using LLMs, providing the encounter management, rubric versioning, provenance capture, and human review infrastructure needed for production assessment deployment.
